original.target_description: Study 1: ordinal knowledge-ascription score (0 immediate denial, 1 delayed denial, 2 unwavering ascription), GEE comparison Standard True Belief versus Gettier cases.

n.sample_role: Participants included in the Standard True Belief versus Gettier knowledge-ascription GEE comparison; repeated vignette responses are not counted as independent participants.
n.exclusions: Methods §2.1: 238 recruited; 16 incomplete and 14 too-fast survey respondents removed, leaving 208. §2.2.1 additionally skips cases failing comprehension and skips knowledge questions following belief denial. The target GEE explicitly prints N=202; the precise additional participant-level exclusion breakdown from 208 to 202 is not provided in the inspected Results. No N inferred from df or response-frequency totals.
